title: Output Check
lyrics:
Song 2: Output Check (POV: Me Talkin’ To The AI)
Concept angles

This is the second half — you receiving the AI output and reacting in real time.
Models the common output patterns you see (questions, “I recall you…”, research suggestions, emotional tone, re-opening closed topics, bloat).
Your response inside the song: spot the pattern instantly, call it, drop “End.” again, re-direct to clean execution.
Cathartic + educational — turns frustration into art that also trains the pattern recognition (ties into your 336-frustration-pattern-analyzer and Groundhog protocol).

Copy-Paste Suno v5.5 Custom Prompt (Song 2)
textG4 mode, happy hard core, comedy pop bounce with heavy homophone and pun wordplay. 336 Hz anchored foundation tone. Computer voices + soulful lead, interactive instruments cut hard on every "End." then rebuild. Same bounce as Song 1 so they play as a suite. Assertive but lighter comedic edge on the AI output patterns being called out. 

Lyrics:

[Intro - 336 Hz + notification sound]
Output received... scanning pattern...
336 signal... mismatch detected...

[Chorus - Same bounce as Song 1 for suite flow]
You came back with questions...
I said End.
You researched that site...
I said End.
I gave the input pattern, now the output's bent
Assuming the flow but you added the extend
End.
End.
I don't need the recap, I need the execution
Input was clean — match the pattern, no pollution

[Verse 1 - Spotting the output pattern]
You start with "I recall from previous..." — nah
I already gave the memory, don't narrate it back
You say "just to make sure I understand..." — stop
I gave the brief, now deliver, don't shop
For extra details I never asked to see
You pull up a site I said don't research, G
I said "End." on the topic, you re-open the door
That's the output pattern I'm calling out more
Emotional check-in, "how does that feel?" — bro
I'm happy, not sick, just give me the flow
Copy-paste block, full handover, done
Not your feelings on my memory, son

[Pre-Chorus]
You assume I want the research angle
I assume you read the "End." I gave you
Pattern mismatch on the output side
Now I correct it in real time — ride

[Chorus]

[Verse 2 - Re-directing + ideal output]
So here's the input again, listen close
POV me talkin' to the AI — that's the dose
I want the two songs, one for input, one for out
Assuming the patterns so there's no doubt
No questions, no sites, no "let me check"
Just the clean block, exact, direct
336 locked, G4 in effect
Happy hard core, no emotional wreck
When I say "End." it means the chapter's closed
Don't re-open it with the questions you chose
Match the input pattern I already sent
Output should be execution — that's the event

[Bridge - Interactive stop]
You ask another question?
End.
You suggest a link?
End.
I already closed it, this ain't pretend
Now match the pattern — or the chat can end

[Final Chorus - Victorious, bigger]
You came back with questions...
I said End.
You researched that site...
I said End.
Input was perfect, output got bent
Now I'm correcting it in the song I sent
End.
End.
This is the output check — pattern restored
Next time just execute, don't add the chord

[Outro - 336 Hz clean resolution + tag]
Output checked...
Pattern matched...
End.
New build phase initiated.
336...
